roleContext.roleTitle: Software Quality Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform
roleContext.jobDescription: The claims platform of a general insurer releases changes to its claims-handling application every two weeks. The Software Quality Engineer owns release quality end-to-end: sets the test strategy, decides scope and exit criteria for each release, holds the quality sign-off that gates production, and is accountable for release quality to the head of engineering.

requirements.text: Owns release quality end-to-end and holds the quality sign-off that gates each production release.
Designs and maintains the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application.
Reproduces and triages defects found in testing and records root causes.
Coordinates test scope with the development leads and claims operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Software Quality Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform

## Experience

- Designed and maintained the automated regression suite for the claims-handling application (Java, Selenium and REST-assured), covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation flows, and kept it running nightly in the pipeline.
- Reproduced and triaged defects from the regression runs and from claims operations' acceptance sessions, recording steps, environment and root cause in the defect tracker.
- Proposed the regression scope for each release in the test planning meeting; the QA lead set the final scope and exit criteria, and the quality sign-off that gated production was given by the QA lead.
- Wrote the release test summary for each release, listing known limitations of the suite (payment flows for reinsured claims were not automated) and the hand-over notes for the support team.
- Responsibilities included regression suite development, defect triage, scope proposals and release test summaries for the claims platform over about three years as one of four quality engineers.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the regression suite's coverage map and one release test summary, with the pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.
